Mira, Great Hall to Saltport: said to take 10 hours, but 100 leagues By ship at 5 leagues an hour takes at least 20 hours.
Mira, Greykeep to Saltport: 92.2 leagues By horse at 30 leagues a day takes at least 3.1 days, but leaving Year 10, January 1 and arriving Year 10, January 2 allows at most 2 days.
Mira, Great Hall to Saltport: said to take 10 hours, but its dates put at least 29.4 days between leaving and arriving.
Orrin, Northreach to Southmarch: said to take 5 years, but its dates allow at most 942.9 days.
Mira takes part in “The ambush” at Loop A while on the journey Great Hall to Saltport (Year 11, January 1 to Year 11, February 1).
Orrin is recorded as located in both Northreach and Southmarch over the same time.
Mira leaves from Upside Village (Year 11, May 1), but last arrived at Great Hall (Year 11, March 20): a journey may be missing.
